text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, having finished both the Japan Cup
and the Arima Kinen, we were making adjustments
for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Please teach me how to race!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A large crowd of junior Umamusume
gathered around Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Dedicate... a race to me?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yes! The Japan Cup and Arima Kinen were just so thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: The stands went totally wild too, going, "I knew this year just wouldn't be the same without Mr. C.B.!"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I want to be able to run cool races just like C.B.-san, too!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I see.
So you watched my last race.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"That got me all fired up too.
There were tons of strong runners, so it was a blast."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Still, I just run by feel, so I might not be that great at teaching.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: P-Please, find a way!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Even if you don't explain it in words,
we'll watch and learn!
Please teach us!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Really? Well then...
Let's just do a quick race for now.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't believe I really get to run!
Whoaaa, I'm gonna learn so much from this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We gathered enough Umamusume active in graded races
to fill the gate and held a race on short notice.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Now, it begins...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gates open, and the Umamusume burst out all at once.
Mr. C.B. settles into the rear,
patiently biding her time to make a move on the lead.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The pace is slow. Listen, in times like this,
you can't rush to the front. Save your strength for the final stretch—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Just then, on the backstretch,
Mr. C.B. lowered her stance,
and then... began accelerating at incredible speed!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, hey.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stands erupted into an uproar. Mr. C.B.
continued accelerating right up the slopeâ

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Aren't hills supposed to be something
you go up slowly and go down slowly?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Normally, that'd be true, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She overtook them one by one
and descended the slope while maintaining her acceleration!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surging into the lead just like that, accelerating even further.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Taaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She had snatched victory away in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're unbelievable!!
...Haha!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haaah... That was so fun!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"So... what do you think?
Did that help give you some ideas?"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*... *phew*...!
Um...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I-It wasn't helpful at all...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Sorry, sorry, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
“B-But she was still amazing!
In a way, she lived right up to the hype...!
I can't copy what she does, but it sure lit a fire in me...!”

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I thought to myself:
I've still got to keep doing my best!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, really?
That's a relief, then.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I had fun too.
Your passion was truly thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it took an unexpected turn...
she seemed to have lived up to her juniors' expectations.
